aboutPage.valuesIntro: Our values reflect our commitment to science, quality and helping people take care of their wellbeing.

values.title: Quality
values.text: Every One is individually tested before it leaves the factory, and every batch of Fizz tablets goes through third-party testing. Quality matters to us because these products are part of our own daily lives.

values.title: Science-based
values.text: We base our work on current science. We closely follow the latest research on molecular hydrogen, so that everything we offer is grounded in what the research supports.

values.title: Customer-centered

questions.question: What is hydrogen water?
questions.answer: Hydrogen water is ordinary drinking water with molecular hydrogen (H₂) gas dissolved in it. Researchers have studied it in a growing number of publications, and while early research is encouraging in several areas, more research is needed to understand it fully.

questions.question: Is hydrogen water safe?
questions.answer: Hydrogen gas has GRAS status ("generally recognized as safe") for use in drinking water and beverages, and in human studies hydrogen water has been well tolerated. Your body even makes hydrogen itself, in your gut, every day.

questions.question: Does hydrogen water taste different?
questions.answer: Hydrogen itself has no taste or smell, so water from the One simply tastes like fresh water. Fizz flavors taste lightly of fruit. [to confirm: taste note for Unflavored]

questions.question: Is hydrogen water the same as alkaline water?
questions.answer: No. The research is about dissolved hydrogen, not pH. Learn more in Myth or fact.

questions.question: Where can I learn more about hydrogen?
questions.answer: Start with Hydrogen 101 for the basics, then see The science for the myths, the facts and the studies.
